documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On 16Th October 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong operational and financial performance for Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenue reaching INR2,013 crores and operating PAT crossing INR100 crores. The company generated positive operating cash flows of approximately INR30 crores during the quarter and maintained working capital at around 60 days. Management emphasized its strategic focus on expanding value-added products, increasing the share of Advance Gold and studded jewelry, and progressing towards a net-debt-free position under its Vision 2030 road map. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported strong financial growth for Q1 FY27, with revenue reaching ₹2,012.8 Crore and PAT increasing to ₹104.9 Crore. Management highlighted strategic priorities under 'Vision 2030: Sky Gold 3.0', including governance enhancement, professionalisation, and a cash-first philosophy where promoters will not draw salaries from FY27.

guidance.claim: The company remains firmly on track to achieve its FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: Revenue for FY27 is projected at approximately ₹8,100 crore.
The EBITDA margin for FY27 is expected to be in the range of ~7.0-7.5%.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margin expected in the range of ~7.0-7.5%

guidance.claim: The PAT margin for FY27 is guided at 4.5% to 4.75%.
By FY30, revenue is expected to reach ~₹18,000 to 19,000 crore.
The company is targeting a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35%, projecting a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.
guidance.quote: We are targeting a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35%, projecting a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.

guidance.claim: Management stated they would stick to the PAT guidance by FY30 but avoid volume guidance due to gold price volatility.
guidance.quote: I want to make a small change to the guidance we have provided in the past. We would like to stick to our PAT guidance by FY30, but we would like to avoid volume guidance primarily because of the volatility in the gold price, which is beyond our control.

guidance.claim: Management guided for a conservative 5.25% PAT margin by FY2030, representing a 75 basis point expansion from current levels.
guidance.quote: While these levers offer strong upside, we have guided for a conservative 5.25% PAT margin by FY2030, which represents an expansion of 75 basis points from current levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects gross margins to expand by 60 to 90 basis points due to a better mix of advanced gold and studded jewellery.
guidance.quote: We expect our gross margin to expand by 60 to 90 basis points due to better mix of advanced gold and studded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: The company witnessed strong initial interest in international markets, building a prospective order pipeline of INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that B2B demand has remained stable without any softening following government measures regarding gold.
demand_outlook.quote: And nowadays retailers have announced so many gold exchange schemes and with gold exchange, they will get more benefit in the making charges. Many schemes are rolled out. We have heard that at the retail level, the gold exchange has gone up from 20% to 40% above.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity utilization is currently close to 55% to 57%, and the company is good on capacity till 2028.
capex_expansion.quote: Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%. And looking at the current projection numbers, we are good till 2028.

capex_expansion.claim: Future capacity expansion after 2028 will likely follow a leased model with an estimated capex of INR80 crores to INR100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And post that, we may look at a new facility, but that we will continue on the leased model, and capex will not be very big. It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time

capex_expansion.claim: The manufacturing footprint is expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects to monetize land by August or September end.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, we have appointed 2 - 3 agencies also. We are expecting it by August end. I think August or September last, we will encash it.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 compared to 9.1% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Operating PAT for the quarter crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time.
margins_costs.quote: Operating PAT for the quarter crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, representing 7.8% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Value-added share of business has surged from <10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Value-Added share of business has surged from <10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins are guided for 10-20 bps improvement Y-o-Y.
margins_costs.quote: However, we guide for 10-20 bps improvement in PAT margins Y-o-Y as we continue investing in new geographies and high-growth categories.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin stands at 8.45%, which is up 245 basis points from 6% in FY24.
margins_costs.quote: From the current year-to-date, our consolidated gross margin stands at 8.45%, up 245 basis points from 6% in FY24.

margins_costs.claim: The company's net working capital days dropped from 71 days for the quarter ended March 25 to 59 days for the quarter ended March 26.
margins_costs.quote: And our net working capital days have successfully dropped from 71 days for quarter ended March '25 to 59 days for this quarter ended March 26.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's production capacity is 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved around 650 kgs per month in Q4.
orders_capacity.quote: Siddharth Sipani: We would like to just inform that in the last Q4, we have done around 650 kgs per month, and that is in line with our guidance that we have provided.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization stands at 55% based on a 1.2-ton capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Mangesh Chauhan: So again, 1.2-ton capacity we have, we are 650 kg last quarter exit. So, we have a 55% utilization. Till 2028 March, we don't have any problem of the capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to report that during quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self- sufficient business model.

capital_allocation.claim: The net debt level for the quarter stands at INR540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Beginning FY27, the company will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model linked entirely to dividends.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model. Going forward, promoter remuneration will be linked entirely to dividends, and dividends will be declared only from operating cash flow generated by the business.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, and all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Dividends will be funded strictly out of operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: Capital distribution discipline: Dividends will be funded strictly out of operating cash flows.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management acknowledged that the wider sector is experiencing a temporary phase of demand softness resulting from tightening conditions and government appeals to curb gold imports.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the wider sector is experiencing a temporary phase of demand softness as a result of this tightening conditions, Sky Gold business model is explicitly built to thrive in such an environment.

management_commitments.claim: The company will revise its revenue guidance after Diwali.
management_commitments.quote: So, we will revise our target after Diwali. We'll analyze one more quarter, and we will give our new guidance post Diwali. That's our plan.

management_commitments.claim: The promoters committed to purchasing a specific property themselves if the sale process was not completed within the stipulated timeframe.
management_commitments.quote: I would also like to reiterate a commitment that I have previously made to our investors. If the sale process were not completed within the stipulated timeframe, the promoters themselves would purchase this property. That commitment remains fully intact.

management_commitments.claim: Beginning FY27, the company will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.
management_commitments.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach an overall target of 52 working capital days by 2030 under Vision 2030.
management_commitments.quote: with an overall target to reach 52 days by 2030 in the Sky Gold Vision 2030 that we are looking at.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, and all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reducing net debt by 50% or above in FY27 through land sale and operational improvement.
management_commitments.quote: We would be reducing net debt by 50% above in FY27 itself through land sale and operational improvement.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve a net debt-free balance sheet by FY30 under Phase 3 organic growth.
management_commitments.quote: Growth will be funded strictly through internal cash generation to achieve a net debt-free balance sheet by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: Management advanced its sales target to reach INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores with a nil net debt position by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: Further, we are happy to announce today that we propose to elevate Akash Talesara, currently President - Sales to the role of CEO, subject to Board approval. This strategic appointment reinforces our commitment to professionalizing management, enforcing strong governance and positioning the company for accelerated growth as we advance towards our FY30 target of achieving sales of INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores with a nil net debt position.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
